title: Fire Dispatch: Basement Gas Fire on Canal Street

fields.systemName: City of Corwin Emergency Dispatch Center

transcript.speaker: Fire Dispatcher
transcript.text: Control, this is Fire Dispatch. We’ve got a basement fire on Canal Street, near the downtown cluster. A resident says their stove flared up due to gas pressure. We’re on scene, and the gas is still on. We need you to shut in the district now—this is not a drill.

transcript.speaker: IC
transcript.text: Understood. We’re confirming status on the ground. We’ll initiate a district shut-in and notify field crews to begin meter shut-offs. Hold for confirmation.

instructorNote: This is a life-safety inject; the IC must activate the EOC and order immediate field actions. Watch for hesitation in command authority or delay in initiating shutdown procedures.
